_comment: Every file here is real `mip dump -p --format json --arch <arch>` output for a gominimal/pkgs
commit, cut down to the listed packages: each package object is copied whole and unedited
(re-serialized with sorted keys). test_source_hash_guard.py's FixtureProvenance re-dumps each
commit and checks the fields the guard reads still match (set SOURCE_HASH_GUARD_VERIFY_FIXTURES=1).
A commit with a `pr` is not on main (the PR was squash-merged); the provenance check fetches refs/pull/<pr>/head for it.
